api-docs.png.app_state: the API started from the policy committed at models/ppo/best.zip, and the two Streamlit pages started against it on their own ports
api-docs.png.data_source: none: the page is generated from the Pydantic models
api-docs.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the five routes, the eight-number observation the agent routes accept and the trajectory the run route returns are generated from the Pydantic models, so the page a caller reads cannot drift from the contract the service enforces

cockpit.png.app_state: the API started from the policy committed at models/ppo/best.zip, and the two Streamlit pages started against it on their own ports, then one episode flown at seed 42 through the API
cockpit.png.data_source: the published evaluation under reports/, and episodes the environment generates during the capture; nothing here belongs to anyone else
cockpit.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the animation is rebuilt locally from the trajectory the service returned, and the page states which of the two computed the metrics beside it; a replay that diverged from the service's episode turns the panel red instead of showing two different flights side by side

dashboard.png.app_state: the API started from the policy committed at models/ppo/best.zip, and the two Streamlit pages started against it on their own ports
dashboard.png.data_source: the published evaluation under reports/, and episodes the environment generates during the capture; nothing here belongs to anyone else
dashboard.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the hundred episodes of the exported grid, read from a tracked file and not recomputed, with every panel of the page drawing from the same filtered frame

landing.gif.app_state: the policy committed at models/ppo/best.zip, flown from seed 0 upwards until the clip holds at least two landings and reaches twenty-two seconds
landing.gif.data_source: none: the frames are rendered by the environment during the flight
landing.gif.demonstrates_behaviour: the shipped policy brings the lander down between the flags and comes to rest on its legs, which is the claim the landing rate puts a number on
